The Good Report according to

Mark

Introduction

The one who wrote this document (LIT reading), was a Hudiyu (MS Hudiyu) named Mark (MS Markus) who was the child of Mariya (Acts 12:12) from Hirusalim (MS Hirusalim). Many of those who study (LIT practice) the Bible, say that he is John Mark, the sibling of Birnabi (Colossians 4:10) that accompanied Paul (MS Pablu) and_company on their first trip in_order_to preach the Good Report (Acts 12:25; 13:13). We(incl) also know that Mark, (he) was a companion of apostle Pidru (1 Pidru 5:13), and many also said that Pidru taught Mark about the work/act(s) and teaching(s) of the Lord Jesus (MS Hisus).

Mark wrote this document for the non Hudiyus, especially those from Ruma. Therefore he only included a little about of what_was_prophecied in the old agreement that was on_the_contrary much written about by Matiyu and Lukas. He also explained some words and customs of the Hudiyus so_that (it) could be understood by the non Hudiyus.

This Good Report that Mark wrote, (it) explains that Jesus was one_who_served God (MS Manama) and people, and he called his self the Child of a Person. The summary (LIT shortcut) verse here can_be_seen in 10:45: “Because even the Child of a Person didn't come here to be served, but rather, in_order_to serve and be_killed in_order to release many people from their sins.” Mark wanted the reader of this document to understand that Jesus always did good, therefore he carefully explained the work(s) of Jesus rather than his teaching(s). He proved (LIT witnessed) the power and authority of Jesus by_means of storying about the wonders that he did, his healing of the sick(pl), and his chasing_out of evil_spirits.

The end of the document (16:9-20) is not in the true source because it is only added. Therefore many think that it wasn't Mark who wrote it.
